_readme: Canonical registry of the three example-shape sets used across segvigen_emissive evaluation galleries. Written by the gallery-runner agent 2026-08-10 while chaining the epoch-8 checkpoint gallery, after 24+ tool calls spent re-deriving these lists with no artifact to check against. v2_split is the split the shape's directory ACTUALLY resolves to in the current dataset_direct build (checked by directory presence, not by any older per-shape 'split_72k' label some source files carry -- those can disagree with the current partition; see fig7_11 notes). provenance is the exact file each list and each caption came from.

fig7_11.label: Dongchen's fig7 picks
fig7_11.description: Picked by Dongchen for the paper's figure 7, the paper's figure examples.
fig7_11.provenance: /project/3dlg-hcvc/omages/yanxg_scratch/handoff_fig7/manifest.json (sid list + caption + old split_72k label); glbs at handoff_fig7/glb/source/<sid>.glb
fig7_11.provenance_note: manifest.json's own 'split_72k' field (from data_splits_74k.json, the pre-repartition split) disagrees with the CURRENT dataset_direct v2 partition for 9/11 of these sids -- see per-shape notes. v2_split below reports the current, operative partition (which directory dataset_direct actually stores the shape under, i.e. what epoch-8 training actually saw), not the stale label.
fig7_11.v2_split_summary: all 11 currently resolve under dataset_direct/val_72k (some also under legacy val72k_condok96* variant dirs) -- a clean held-out read against the CURRENT partition, even though the old per-shape split_72k label calls most of them train/test. Confirmed by directory search, not by this label.

showcase_12.label: our picked showcase assets
showcase_12.description: Our picked showcase assets, from paper_v3 manifest12 -- the rendering-methodology page's teaser and family-panel shapes (bloom sweep, strength ladder, box-render comparisons).
showcase_12.provenance: /project/3dlg-hcvc/omages/yanxg_scratch/paper_v3/manifest12.json (sid list); captions summarized from the long 'cap' field in paper_v3/manifest.json (26-shape superset)
showcase_12.provenance_note: These 12 were NEVER in the 72k train/val/test catalog (data_splits_74k.json) or in dataset_direct before 2026-08-10 -- absent-from-catalog is the correct v2_split value up to that point. They ARE in the TexVerse-1K source parquet and already had Dongchen's ovoxel ground truth, so preprocessing was a normal sidfile build (build_dataset_direct.py + build_cond_thumbnail.py), not a from-scratch pipeline. Built into dataset_direct/ours12 on 2026-08-10 (job 242802, 12/12 ok, 0 failures, cond.pth coverage 12/12) for the epoch-8 gallery. Being genuinely held out (never in ANY train/val split), results on this set are the most trustworthy generalization read of the three.

fbv1_8.label: familiar fbv1 showcase set
fbv1_8.description: The familiar old-showcase comparison shapes, used across the first-72k-checkpoint gallery and earlier evaluation pages.
fbv1_8.provenance: /project/3dlg-hcvc/omages/yanxg_scratch/fbv1_repro/manifest.json and sids.json (sid list, no captions carried); glbs at fbv1_repro/glb/
fbv1_8.provenance_note: IMPORTANT, previously undocumented: dataset_direct/fbv1_8/<sid> is a SYMLINK to dataset_direct/train_72k/<sid> for all 8 shapes (verified: readlink + content-identical meta.json). This set is NOT held out -- every shape in it was in the model's training split, unlike fig7_11 and showcase_12. No caption source was found for these 8; team should treat that as a gap, not an omission.
fbv1_8.v2_split_summary: all 8 resolve under dataset_direct/train_72k -- this set is IN the training split, not held out. Flagged separately to team-lead; affects how any generalization claim from this gallery should be worded.
